name: 層疊剪影霧林・Blender 原型
description: 同一個霧林構圖在 Blender 一次烘好（體積霧、出口光暈、水面倒影），執行時只畫會動的：依深度增減的霧、水面漣漪、小燈、雨與閃電。
description_en: One misty forest scene baked once in Blender (volumetric fog, glow at the exit, reflections); at run time only what moves is drawn: fog by depth, ripples, small lights, rain and lightning.
